title: When a chief executive sorts it out, what changes for the next family?
summary: A personal intervention can solve one problem while leaving the same barrier for the next family. Drawing on Leading for Place, I ask who owes residents an answer about changes to rules, funding, and responsibility.

title: Myron’s maxims: participation, power, and the work of change
summary: An examination of participation, direction, real work, and responsibility. What do useful maxims hide when they are treated as universal truths?

title: Where are the systems in ‘systems leadership’?
summary: Investigating and changing recurring patterns, including our own part in them. A combined essay on leadership development, public health, power, and the conditions that keep problems recurring.
